completeness_note: All23 cosmetic subcategory pages advertised on the root were checked with verified TLS;7 online base references and1 grouped vegetable-oil reference found. The21 empty online categories were supplemented from the official cosmetics cataloguePDF (catalogues/13/download), all5pages fully transcribed,178 distinct explicitly named rawmaterials/bases, deduplicating repeated references and clear synonyms while retaining originalsource names and citations.11oil examples named on the groupedwebproductpage are preserved, ofwhich3 do not occur in PDF. Total189 named catalogue references/materials beforecrossrange dedup, including8onlinecards,178PDFnames and3additionalwebcitedoils. Differently branded base names remain separate unless manufacturer equivalence is explicit. This is the complete setofexplicitnames discoverable in these officialsources, notanassertionofall320manufacturerSKUs.

anomalies.note: 21 of23 cosmetic online subcategory pages explicitly display Aucun produit trouvé, but the official downloadable cosmetics catalogue supplies178 named rawmaterials/bases over5pages covering allthe listed ingredient families.

One vegetable-oil web listing names11 example oils;8 already appear in the official cosmeticsPDF, while onagre, rose musquée and camomille are additionally sourced from the official detail page. All11 tracked under the product;3 extra in root named_materials.

BIOMA SOAP vs BIOMA luxury soap (MELT & POUR), BIOMA EC90 vs BIOMA luxury EC 90 (Full care/ make cream), and BIOMA Hair Care vs BIOMA luxury HAIR CARE Free sulfate have distinct official URLs; retained without guessing whether duplicates.

Catalogue contains spelling errors; source_name and normalizationnotes retained. Two ambiguous original names preserved: Cocodiethanoalme and Alcool cétearylique(C18). Generic oil/perfume family text not invented as individual products.

transcription.method: Transcription intégrale des cinq pages du catalogue officiel, comparaison visuelle des pages 3 et 5 avec les listes extraites ; trois colonnes toutes parcourues. Noms d’affichage normalisés sans changer source_name. Une entrée par référence explicitement nommée, noms co-listés séparés ; répétitions et synonymes sûrs fusionnés.
